tables.transform: Source history uses both signed-delta and positive-magnitude EGRESO conventions. For EGRESO, canonical destination cantidad=abs(source cantidad) and delta_stock=-abs(source cantidad); negative source values retain their exact value in delta_stock. INGRESO requires positive source cantidad and maps both cantidad/delta_stock unchanged. AJUSTE remains fail-closed.

DEMO_ONLY_ZERO_ROW_CUTOVER_NOT_APPLICABLE: cash closure and final data delta/export may be waived only after the local fail-closed validator proves every condition in data-migration.json for the reviewed migration set.

OPERATIONAL_CUTOVER_REQUIRED.rule: Freeze writes, close/reconcile source cash sessions, take FINAL_BASELINE, then export the final delta.

DEMO_ONLY_ZERO_ROW_CUTOVER_NOT_APPLICABL.rule: Only the explicit zero-row demo-only migration set recorded in data-migration.json may use this outcome after local validation. This does not waive destination bootstrap, security, Auth, topology, or smoke-test requirements.

policies.businessUUID: Preserve business UUIDs where target PK allows; collision or malformed UUID blocks.
policies.auth: Recreate/invite users and map new Auth UUID explicitly; never copy password hashes, tokens, sessions or secrets.
policies.nulls: Preserve NULL only when target permits it; otherwise quarantine. Never silently convert NULL to zero/empty/default.
policies.defaults: Apply only target defaults semantically equivalent to source absence; record each application.
policies.money: Exact NUMERIC(12,2), tolerance 0.00. producto_costos is the valid current-cost source; do not use productos.precio_costo (aggregate 0.00).
policies.quantities: Exact NUMERIC(12,3), no rounding absent approved deterministic rule.
policies.time: Preserve instant after source timezone is proven; DATE stays a civil date.
policies.tenant: Validate every FK and same-kiosk ownership before accepting a row.
policies.privacy: No tokens, password/PIN hashes, secrets, AFIP/CAE payloads or excluded payment credentials in bundles/reports.

entities.transform: PRE_CUTOVER artifact: source writers used two EGRESO forms: legacy direct writers stored signed negative cantidad, while the checkout trigger stores positive magnitude and signs delta_stock negative. Canonicalize target cantidad=abs(source cantidad) and delta_stock=-abs(source cantidad) for EGRESO; this preserves the signed value exactly for negative source rows and derives direction for positive magnitudes using the verified movement type contract. INGRESO requires positive cantidad and maps cantidad/delta_stock unchanged. AJUSTE remains fail-closed. Never replay the business stock RPC.

entities.reconcile: 122 PRE rows; source quantity counts/sums remain reported by source type without normalization; canonical target delta is reported separately from per-row values. Observed source: 3 INGRESO positive, 113 EGRESO negative, 6 EGRESO positive, 0 AJUSTE. Reconcile exact canonical delta totals and authoritative stock snapshot separately; never compare the signed raw source quantity sum directly to canonical delta sum.

triggerStrategy.decision: C1 selects no destructive trigger action. Do not load history through live business RPCs or disable/drop destination triggers. C2 must design a target-only, non-browser, dedicated migration principal and transaction-scoped import pathway that preserves validation/tenant constraints while suppressing only duplicate operational side effects. Triggers must explicitly support the reviewed import mode, or staging relations plus reviewed promotion logic must prevent repeated stock/cash/audit effects. No such mechanism is implemented or authorized in C1.
triggerStrategy.c2Gate: Prove locally against clean bootstrap: rollback, no partial effects, no stock/cash/audit duplication, and required constraints/security remain active.

reconciliation.countsKeysFK: Exact included counts and PK UUID sets after classification; duplicate PK=0, FK orphan=0, cross-kiosk=0.
reconciliation.financial: NUMERIC exact, tolerance 0.00, by kiosk and semantic group.
reconciliation.stock: Compare authoritative products.stock_actual per kiosk/product, lots, and compatible signed movement deltas separately; never reconstruct snapshot from old movement sum.
reconciliation.cost: 284 producto_costos rows, sum 1169130.00 PRE; one missing cost row stays missing. 63 movement-cost rows; 59 absent rows stay absent.
reconciliation.sales: Counts/totals headers, lines, payments; state counts/totals; preserve ANULADA history; no annulment replay.
reconciliation.cash: Operational cutover requires freeze, cash closure/reconciliation, and a final baseline with zero open sessions; only closed sessions/movements import and destination begins with no open session. The demo-only zero-row exception is limited to the explicit reviewed migration set and waives only cash closure/final data delta/export after local validator PASS.
reconciliation.emptyDomains: Customers/CC and providers/purchases/details/payments remain exact zero unless final baseline documents a delta; no fabricated balances.
reconciliation.auth: Eligible profiles map one-to-one to recreated Auth identities; exclude 9 profileless Auth users; migrate zero credentials/tokens.
